name: join-self-fact
description: Measure fact self-joins with identical keys and payload access

queries.name: self-inner
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.category FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.event_id = f.event_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: self-left
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.amount FROM events e LEFT JOIN events f ON e.event_id = f.event_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: self-inner-desc
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.quantity FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.event_id = f.event_id ORDER BY e.event_id DESC LIMIT 20
